column1: # AT_CAPACITY measured on lab4 (nftables 1.0.9, kernel 5.14) in isolated network
# namespaces, positive and negative controls green FIRST:
#   set size 1, limit 5, three distinct sources -> the 2nd and 3rd sources
#   CONNECT and the rule counter stays 0. Insertion failure means the expression
#   does not match, so the rule does not act => FAIL_OPEN.
# Growth is bounded by CONCURRENT distinct sources, not cumulative: 8 sources
# connected+closed produced 8 elements, reclaimed to 0 within 30s while their
# conntrack entries were still present. These sets therefore carry NO timeout by
# design (a timeout could expire an element with live connections) and are not
# subject to the 2026-08-04 monotonic-growth failure mode.
